name: reelagentic
description: ReelAgentic: your AI reel editor. Turns Claude into a reel editor for macOS and Windows. Cuts pauses and retakes, cleans the voice, auto-grades, word-by-word captions in 50+ languages, text behind you and green-screen cutouts, 49 motion effects, beat-synced zooms and transitions, speed ramps, SFX, storyboard approval, Instagram-ready render (-14 LUFS, safe zones), cover and post caption.
